baslik: The Mining Dam That Turned to Liquid in Seconds

sahneler.metin: A mining waste dam in Brazil collapsed in seconds.
A wave of mud buried offices and a cafeteria, and two hundred seventy people were killed.
The dam was built on top of its own waste.
That waste was still saturated with water.
Suddenly, it lost its strength and flowed like liquid.
The dam had been certified stable months before.
It became one of Brazil's worst industrial disasters.
Brazil then banned this type of dam.
